fm_reference: FM24 Match Day: live match engine, commentary, touchline instructions
biggest_gap: The live match has no visual depiction of the battle itself: the arena is two text stat-cards and a 'VS' label with large empty space, so 'watching' the match means reading the ticker. FM24's match day is anchored by a watchable rendered match. Fix: an animated arena centerpiece (sprites/silhouettes of the two active Pokemon, move/hit/faint/switch animations synced to the event stream, sized to fill the empty card space).
